view: AP portable frontal chest radiograph (supine/semi-erect), L marker at image upper right confirming conventional orientation
technical_quality: Suboptimal: portable AP technique with the patient rotated and the field obliquely collimated (image tilted), head turned to the left, both arms abducted with soft-tissue overlap laterally, shallow inspiration with low lung volumes, the lower thorax/upper abdomen partially clipped by the collimator, and the lung bases relatively underpenetrated. Multiple ECG leads overlie the chest.

abnormalities.finding: Diffuse coarse reticulonodular and patchy alveolar opacities throughout both lungs, most confluent in the mid and lower zones, right more than left, with perihilar accentuation
Both hemidiaphragms and costophrenic angles obscured by basal opacity; layering pleural effusion or basal consolidation/atelectasis not excluded on this supine film
Prominent/widened cardiomediastinal silhouette with partially obscured cardiac borders; heart size indeterminate given AP supine technique, rotation and adjacent lung opacity
Possible streaky lucencies in the left lateral chest wall and axillary soft tissues, suspicious for subcutaneous emphysema (low confidence, partly overlapped by lead wires and abducted arm)
No definite visceral pleural line identified; a small or anteromedial pneumothorax cannot be excluded on a supine film with extensive parenchymal opacity

description_zh: AP前後位臥姿攜帶式胸部X光，病人有旋轉、吸氣不足且影像傾斜，下胸部部分被準直框切除；右上及左上前胸壁見心電圖電極，多條導線投影於左側胸壁、縱膈及胸腔外，未見胸管、氣管內管或中心靜脈導管。兩側肺野瀰漫性粗網狀結節及斑片狀肺泡浸潤，以中下肺野最為明顯，右側較左側嚴重，兩側橫膈及肋膈角均模糊不清，無法排除臥姿層狀肋膜積液或肺底實變。心臟縱膈輪廓略顯寬大，惟因AP臥姿技術及肺部病灶遮蔽而不易評估；未見明確臟層肋膜線，但左側側胸壁及腋下軟組織疑有條紋狀透亮影，需注意皮下氣腫及潛在氣胸之可能。骨骼結構未見明顯骨折，肱骨頭可見生長板，符合青少年年齡。
